title: JSFL timeline: copyFrames, cutFrames, pasteFrames, reverseFrames, clearFrames, addMotionGuide missing
description:
Implemented all 6 methods in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:
- clearFrames: blanks keyframes in range (label/script/sound/displayObjects cleared)
- reverseFrames: delegates to coreReverseFrames (promotes span frames, then reverses content)
- copyFrames/cutFrames/pasteFrames: backed by engine copyFramesDoc/cutFramesDoc/pasteFramesDoc; FrameClipboard stored on RuntimeState
- addMotionGuide: inserts guide layer above current layer; sets current layer type to 'guided'
